newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends mostly down ahead of data.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends mostly down ahead of data.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices ended mostly lower after a quietly steady opening. The easiness reflected some liquidation ahead of crop estimates from Ivan Wong on Friday and official PORLA key May data on Monday. Cautious trade was seen. August will trade in the range of 1,180 and 1,200 ringgit.
PALM OIL PHYSICALS - Buyers mostly sidelined, with trend following futures. Interest seen among CPOs and selected oils.
Price movements were limited due to the reluctance of players to take up fresh positions ahead of crop estimates.
Futures contracts were traded in a 11-ringgit range level, they said.
After a higher opening on soyoil, the market slipped off thereafter as lack of follow-through support and scattered liquidation emerged in the afternoon sessions.
Trading was inactive as compared to last few days, and turnover on the futures market was 1,024 lots.
"August is likely to trade in the range of 1,180 and 1,200 until the release of May data," a trader said.
At the close, August futures contract closed six ringgit down at 1,186 ringgit ($472.23) a tonne.
Physicals June (south) saw offers at 1,227.50 ringgit against bids at 1,225 after trading at 1,225 earlier. June (central) was offered at 1,215 versus 1,210 with earlier trades at 1,215 and 1,210.
July (south) saw offers at 1,225 after bids of 1,220 and trades of 1,220 and 1,225. July (central) saw offers at 1,215 against bids of 1,210.
In refined products, July RBD palm oil was offered at $515, and Aug/Sept at $512.50.
July RBD palm olein saw offers at $557.50, and Aug/Sept at $552.50. Aug/Sept was traded at $552.50.
July/Aug RBD palm stearin was offered at $382.50 and June/July palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $275.
